data.body:
Starting execution in worktree xanclomys-fix. Classification of each in-scope HMAC reference against current code (ADR 0049 + docs/migrations/hmac-opcert-removal.md verified against src): 

- docs/attest-substrate.md — CORRECT: the `rebar.attest.hmac_legacy` module/scheme is retired (src/rebar/attest has no hmac_legacy; __init__ registers only sshsig+authorship+opcert policies). Header, module table, import note, trust_root/sign examples, and the 'HMAC legacy' section describe removed registry behavior; reword to retired-legacy + point to migration record.
- docs/config.md — CORRECT: snapshot section now has an 'Operation-certificate trust model and limits' section in repo-snapshot-gates.md; 'HMAC trust model' link text is stale.
- docs/exit-codes.md — CORRECT: verify-signature is now shape-aware (verifies asymmetric op-certs and legacy records); 'HMAC signature verified' is stale.
- docs/identity.md — CORRECT: verify-signature certifies manifest attestations from `rebar sign`, which now mints asymmetric op-certs (sign_manifest -> mint_opcert_record), not HMAC.
- docs/llm-framework.md — CORRECT (no 'hmac' keyword): the 'Trust model' paragraph describes the pre-op-cert single-canonical-MCP-key/foreign_key model; update to per-environment Ed25519 op-cert (verify-by-anyone) + trusted_environments.yaml merge gate per ADR 0049.
- src/rebar/_lib_identity.py — CORRECT: sign_manifest docstring says HMAC-SHA256 + legacy return shape; now DSSE/SSHSIG op-cert with envelope/principal/material_fingerprint/merged_log_commit (types.py SignResult).
- src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py — CORRECT: verify_signature tool says 'Recomputes the HMAC'; shape-aware verify.
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py — CORRECT: two comments call the product an 'HMAC attestation'/'HMAC sign'; attest.sign_plan_review mints an op-cert.

GENERIC HMAC utility (rebar.signing.compute_signature/verify_record/.signing-key) is intentionally retained for non-op-cert consumers and will not be relabelled. ADRs/migrations/experiments untouched.
